description: Get one 3D conformer of a compound — atomic coordinates and bonds — for one CID: its default conformer, or the one conformerId names. format="json" (default) returns atoms and bonds parsed into structured fields; format="sdf" returns the raw V2000 SDF text for passthrough to docking, rendering, or conformer tools. Optionally lists the compound's other conformer IDs, each one a value for conformerId. Not every compound has computed 3D coordinates (large molecules, mixtures, and some salts do not).

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

conformerId.description: Fetch this conformer of the compound instead of its default: a conformer ID from alternateConformerIds (includeAlternateConformerIds: true), 16 hexadecimal digits whose first 8 are the CID in hexadecimal (e.g. "000008C40000000B" for CID 2244). Either case is accepted. Omit, or leave blank, for the default conformer.

format.description: Output format. "json" (default) returns parsed atoms and bonds. "sdf" returns the raw V2000 SDF text for passthrough to other tools.

includeAlternateConformerIds.description: List the IDs of the compound's other computed conformers, each one a value for conformerId. Slower than the default response. Default: false.

includeRawSdf.description: For format="sdf", return the complete raw V2000 SDF even when it exceeds the safe line cap. Default false: an SDF longer than 500 lines is line-capped with disclosure. No effect when format="json".

maxAtoms.description: Cap the atoms returned in the format="json" preview. atomCount always reports the full total; omitted rows are disclosed via the truncated/shownAtoms enrichment. Defaults to the first 200 atoms.

maxBonds.description: Cap the bonds returned in the format="json" preview. bondCount always reports the full total; omitted rows are disclosed via the truncated/shownBonds enrichment. Defaults to the first 200 bonds.

name: pubchem_get_compound_3d_structure

alternateConformerIds.description: The compound's other conformer IDs — every listed ID except the one returned, the default included when another was requested. Pass one as conformerId to fetch that conformer. Present when includeAlternateConformerIds is set and other conformers exist.

atomCap.description: The atom cap applied (explicit maxAtoms or the safe default), when the atom list was capped.

atomCount.description: Number of atoms in the conformer.

bondCap.description: The bond cap applied (explicit maxBonds or the safe default), when the bond list was capped.

bondCount.description: Number of bonds in the conformer.

conformerId.description: ID of the conformer returned: the requested conformerId, or the compound's default conformer. Read from the record's PUBCHEM_CONFORMER_ID data item; omitted when the record carries none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_3d_structure`: PubChem returned 404 for the CID's 3D record, its answer both when the compound has no computed 3D conformer (common for very large molecules, mixtures, and undefined salts) and when no compound has the CID. `invalid_conformer_id`: conformerId is not 16 hexadecimal digits whose first 8 name a CID, or the CID they name is not cid. `conformer_not_found`: PubChem returned 404 for the requested conformerId, its answer both for an ID the compound has no conformer under and for any ID of a compound with no computed 3D conformer. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance naming which lists were capped and how to widen them.

sdf.description: Raw V2000 SDF text. Populated when format="sdf".

shownAtoms.description: Atoms returned after the cap, when fewer than atomCount. Raise maxAtoms for more.

shownBonds.description: Bonds returned after the cap, when fewer than bondCount. Raise maxBonds for more.

shownSdfLines.description: SDF lines returned when format="sdf" and the raw text was line-capped. Set includeRawSdf for the full record.

truncated.description: True when the atom list, bond list, or raw SDF was capped below its total. atomCount/bondCount always report the full totals.

title: Get Compound 3D Structure
